# Suryansh Mishra · Art

> The art portfolio and shop of Suryansh Mishra: ballpoint pen hyper-realistic portraits, pencil and marker illustration and manga-inspired concept art, with limited edition prints and portrait and concept art commissions.

Suryansh Mishra is an AI engineer from Noida, India. He is the co-founder and CTO of Alethman and a forward deployed engineer at InboxKit. He also paints and writes poetry. This site, art.suryanshmishra.com, is where his artwork lives.

## This site
- [Art portfolio and shop](https://art.suryanshmishra.com/): selected works, about the artist, prints and commissions, contact

## Suryansh Mishra elsewhere
- [suryanshmishra.com](https://suryanshmishra.com/): his home, an open world that leads to each of his sites
- [About Suryansh Mishra](https://suryanshmishra.com/about/): who he is, in plain text
- [Coding portfolio](https://code.suryanshmishra.com/): his engineering work
- [Bonfire](https://bonfire.suryanshmishra.com/): his blog of poems and thoughts
